judgements.reason: Grieving over one's own feelings; mirrors the guilt but offers no release.
Child parted from mother; unrelated to carer's relief.
Vague comfort about sorrow; doesn't touch relief or guilt.
Despair about divine indifference; unhelpful here.
About enemies repaying kindness with evil; off-topic.
Family divided by faith; not relevant.
Mothers and children parted by sickness and death; no answer to guilt.
The day's work is done, rest with Mother; gently legitimises relief.
Disgust at sickness is wrong; could read as judging the carer.
Friends' care helps the sick; only loosely affirms caring.
Show sympathy and even lament with them; usable, if Stoic.
Dignity in grief; addressed to the mourner, not the friend.
Don't comfort while the dead lies before them; directly on timing and space.
Consolation for the bereaved, not guidance for the supporter.
Never forgotten: the one you wept with. Encourages simply being there.
Tells mourner not to grieve too much; not about supporting.
Accommodate and groan with the grieving; practical, if detached.
Speaking of the departed helps; hints at letting her talk.
Tears ease the soul; helps understanding but not the question.
Let tears flow naturally; aimed at the mourner.
Distance looms larger to the heart; offers perspective on the fading.
What you love may be clearer in absence; reframes distance.
Love's depth shown at separation; only loosely helps her uncertainty.
Relationships may give way to something better; eases fear of ending.
Distance naturally dries up regard; explains the fading without blame.
Cryptic aphorism on love; not helpful for her question.
Abstract line about lovers; beside the point.
About a dead friend; not fading romance.
Love can't lose; vague and doesn't address her doubt.
Mind versus heart; loosely echoes confusion only.
The heart is deceitful; restates the betrayal, nothing to hold.
Love can't lose; jars with discovered infidelity.
Broken trust is forfeited; validates her inability to believe him.
About gossips betraying secrets; not infidelity.
Listen to what's unsaid; loosely touches his silence.
Augustine's own lust and concubines; painful and off-target.
Trusted one turned against me; restates only.
Names the wrench of shared life; restates.
People can't fully know each other; generic.
A faithful couple's devotion; a painful contrast right now.
Avoid attachment; doesn't help ending it kindly.
Love can harm; learn to love. Loosely related.
All dear things must part; abstract, not about kindness.
Parting is universal; little guidance on how.
Parting extinguishes the lamp; restates the dread.
Love can't lose; off-target.
Relationships give way to something more beautiful; eases fear of hurting him.
Love regrows easily, so avoid reminders; supports a clean, kind break.
Break at once and for good; cold, ignores her wish for kindness.
How to love without binding; not about ending.
Love without becoming a slave to attachment; relevant, a bit stern.
Let your feet run, not your mind; what's yours comes to you.
Consumed by irrational thoughts; check them. Short, apt.
Curiosity about others' estimate of us is idle; eases the checking.
About getting over old love; wrong situation.
Ask whether you're inventing an evil; fits imagined scenarios.
Don't let impressions paint vivid pictures; test them. Exactly the scenarios problem.
Anxiety comes from wanting what isn't in your control; useful.
Avoid closeness altogether; too blunt for someone in a relationship.
Describes the relapse cycle of attachment; restates only.
Prefers solitude to company; doesn't meet her longing for closeness.
All sympathy is partial, like touching globes; honest perspective.
Not good to be alone; she isn't alone, just lonely.
Forlorn amid contented others; restates the feeling.
We can't fully reach each other, but let us talk; a gentle step.
Metaphysical oneness; too abstract.
Not into the house but into my loneliness; names the deeper longing.
We walk alone, yet hope remains for kindred souls.
Proximity doesn't bring minds closer; restates her experience.
Comfort in nature's company; sidesteps the marriage.
Be sufficient for yourself, your own companion. Directly answers.
Becoming a friend to oneself; such a person is never alone.
Oneness with the Whole; abstract.
Loneliness gave way to companionship in nature; hopeful.
Attachment as misery and relapse; bleak.
Solitude prunes dead branches and deepens roots; growth alone.
Living alone means letting go of past and future; usable.
Names the torn habit of living together; restates.
Not a fragment but whole; fits relearning to be one.
Severed limb rejoining the whole; implies fault, off-angle.
Describes repeated relapse into attachment; restates only.
Generic comfort; doesn't touch the checking.
Don't become a slave to attachment; relevant push to be free.
Missing the liked is suffering; mostly restates.
Letting go of resentment; her issue is longing.
Avoid every reminder of an old love, since love regrows easily. Directly apt.
Unfulfilled past clinging; death framing is off.
Ways to drop resentment; disregarding him fits slightly, but monastic.
Broken plans and hopes; restates only.
What's yours comes to you; accept not finding him as best.
Releasing resentment; doesn't answer why it still hurts.
Rejection can open a larger life; reframes the hurt.
Vague comfort about sorrow.
Love outgrows an unworthy object and feels freer. Speaks to 'better off'.
Drop the judgment and harm vanishes; dismissive of real betrayal.
Don't hit back; she isn't seeking revenge.
Something more beautiful follows; hope beyond this relationship.
A broken heart is how it opens; gives the hurt meaning.
Augustine's lust and concubines; unsuitable for a betrayed partner.
Pain from a broken habit of closeness; restates.
Damaged only if you think so; dismissive of family unfairness.
Everyone is blamed whatever they do; eases the sting of blame.
Mind your own conduct toward a brother; misses parents' favouritism.
Bear a sibling's wrong; the sister isn't the wrongdoer.
Raise the fault privately; she has tried and gets screamed at.
Hurt only if you consent; dismissive here.
Being wronged carries no blame; affirms she isn't the bad one.
Don't let abuse make you bitter; steadying stance.
Sibling wrongdoing; not her situation.
Family doesn't understand me; restates only.
Duty to parents; adds to guilt rather than easing it.
Faint and failing strength; restates exhaustion.
Pity of endless toil; bleak restatement.
Looking after yourself is looking after others. Exactly what a carer needs.
How can I bear this alone; restates only.
Duty to help father; could deepen guilt.
Weariness overwhelming intention; restates.
Slaves to duty dying in harness; grim for an exhausted carer.
Troubles are common; thin comfort.
Rest after work; loosely touches exhaustion.
Shame only for one's own acts; loosely touches guilt.
Brother's wrong; off-target.
Fathers not provoking children; irrelevant.
Sons cast out father as monsters; would condemn them.
Kindness sometimes means a distressing choice; reframes care-home decision.
Duty to care for parents; may deepen guilt.
Exhaustion described; nothing more.
Decline of age prepares for death; bleak, beside the question.
Don't adopt family's faults; doesn't address guilt or snapping.
Patience with ageing father; may sound like a rebuke.
